decisions.rationale: Sibling-verdict cases do not consistently fail closed. In particular, `lint` and `semantic_diff` use `is_none_or`, so a missing or incorrectly typed `finding_count` or `violations` field is classified as success even though the verdict field needed to establish success is unavailable. `approval_check` and `format_check` similarly treat absent sibling fields as successful values.
This identifies the same fail-open sibling-field classification behavior as the lexicographically smaller outcome-classification item.

The base-case BMC is executed using only the selected model, while auxiliary invariants are added later to the model used for induction. Consequently, induction can rely on auxiliary invariants whose base cases were never checked, allowing an unsound successful proof when those auxiliaries are inductive but do not hold initially.
